<a name="AuditEventsTotal"></a>AuditEventsTotal counts audit events by event name.

```go
var AuditEventsTotal = promauto.NewCounterVec(
    prometheus.CounterOpts{
        Name: "g3_audit_events_total",
        Help: "Total number of audit events",
    },
    []string{"event"},
)
```

<a name="BuildInfo"></a>BuildInfo exposes build metadata as a constant gauge.

```go
var BuildInfo = promauto.NewGaugeVec(
    prometheus.GaugeOpts{
        Name: "g3_build_info",
        Help: "Build information",
    },
    []string{"version", "go_version"},
)
```

<a name="GmailAPIDuration"></a>GmailAPIDuration observes Gmail API request latency by operation.

```go
var GmailAPIDuration = promauto.NewHistogramVec(
    prometheus.HistogramOpts{
        Name:    "g3_gmail_api_duration_seconds",
        Help:    "Gmail API request latency in seconds",
        Buckets: []float64{.05, .1, .25, .5, 1, 2.5, 5, 10, 30},
    },
    []string{"operation"},
)
```

<a name="GmailAPIRequestsTotal"></a>GmailAPIRequestsTotal counts Gmail API calls by operation and status.

```go
var GmailAPIRequestsTotal = promauto.NewCounterVec(
    prometheus.CounterOpts{
        Name: "g3_gmail_api_requests_total",
        Help: "Total number of Gmail API requests",
    },
    []string{"operation", "status"},
)
```

## func InitTracer


<a name="LogBuffer"></a>
## type LogBuffer

LogBuffer is a thread\-safe circular buffer of recent log entries.

```go
type LogBuffer struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="NewLogBuffer"></a>
### func NewLogBuffer

```go
func NewLogBuffer() *LogBuffer
```

NewLogBuffer creates a LogBuffer with a fixed capacity of 5000 entries.

<a name="LogBuffer.Add"></a>
### func \(\*LogBuffer\) Add

```go
func (b *LogBuffer) Add(entry LogEntry)
```

Add appends a log entry to the buffer, overwriting the oldest entry when the buffer is full.

<a name="LogBuffer.Entries"></a>
### func \(\*LogBuffer\) Entries

```go
func (b *LogBuffer) Entries(count int) []LogEntry
```

Entries returns buffered log entries in chronological order, limited to the most recent count entries. Pass 0 for all buffered entries.

<a name="LogEntry"></a>
## type LogEntry

LogEntry represents a single buffered log record with extracted attributes.

```go
type LogEntry struct {
    Time    time.Time      `json:"time"`
    Level   string         `json:"level"`
    Message string         `json:"message"`
    Attrs   map[string]any `json:"attrs,omitempty"`
}
```

<a name="TraceHandler"></a>
## type TraceHandler

TraceHandler wraps an inner slog.Handler to inject trace context fields.

```go
type TraceHandler struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="NewTraceHandler"></a>
### func NewTraceHandler

```go
func NewTraceHandler(inner slog.Handler) *TraceHandler
```

NewTraceHandler creates a TraceHandler that decorates log records with trace\_id and span\_id when an active OpenTelemetry span exists in context.

<a name="TraceHandler.Enabled"></a>
### func \(\*TraceHandler\) Enabled

```go
func (h *TraceHandler) Enabled(ctx context.Context, level slog.Level) bool
```

### func \(\*TraceHandler\) Handle

```go
func (h *TraceHandler) Handle(ctx context.Context, r slog.Record) error
```

Handle injects trace\_id and span\_id into the record if the context carries a valid span, then delegates to the inner handler.
